report_topic: Welfare of Building and Other Construction Workers
observations_summary: The audit found significant under-registration of establishments and workers, leading to a substantial shortfall in cess collection (₹542.17 crore) and non-realization of interest (₹11.39 crore). Welfare benefits were delayed or denied due to insufficient funds and unreliable beneficiary data, while the Board's cash balance declined sharply and safety regulations were not enforced at worksites.
